Can we try it before deciding?
Yes. Explore the free 3D demo and request a demonstration focused on your school’s needs.
Does it replace our Spanish curriculum?
Use the library alongside your programme. Your teachers choose which materials to include and when.
Does each teacher have their own account?
Yes. Current accounts are individual. Discuss team access and conditions during the demo; passwords are not shared.
Is there already a school administration dashboard?
Not yet. Institution management, invitations and licence assignment from a dashboard are pending implementation. Request a demo to discuss the access options available today.
How much does it cost for a school?
There is no public institutional price. Ask about options for your team. Independent teacher plans and subscriptions remain available.
